Perked_Sensitive_Ears.description: Perked_Sensitive_Ears sprout from a wolf-like head, swiveling and pointed to catch even the faintest whispers of high-frequency sounds, enhancing your awareness by threefold.

Swivel_Hunter_Ears.description: The Swivel_Hunter_Ears, with their sharp triangular edges and feline grace, grant a cat-like hunter exceptional auditory prowess, swiveling to pinpoint every whisper of prey.

Elongated_Directional_Ears.description: Elongated Directional Ears, akin to those of a nimble hare, grant keen directional hearing and heightened alertness, allowing swift detection of even the faintest sounds from any direction.

Echolocation_Ears.description: These large, bat-like ears pulse with ultrasonic sonar, granting enhanced echolocation that pierces darkness and reveals secrets hidden by sound alone.
